top_stories.title: Can the second coming of Tony Abbott resurrect the Liberal party? Or is it another step towards ‘self-destruction’ | Tony Abbott | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Angus Taylor**, the newly appointed leader of the **Liberal** party, has chosen **Tony Abbott** as president to help revive the struggling party.  Abbott's return to active politics comes after a seven-year absence and is expected to influence policy decisions, particularly on immigration and cultural issues.  While some Liberals welcome Abbott's leadership and his potential to address their concerns, others fear he will become a divisive figure within the party, potentially hindering its chances of winning elections. The appointment has sparked debate about whether Abbott's hardline views will resonate with voters and if he can effectively lead the party back to power.

top_stories.title: Moody's upgrades Reliance Industries rating to Baa1, now 2 notches above India's sovereign rating - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Reliance Industries** has been upgraded two notches above India's sovereign rating by both **Moody's** and **S&P Global Ratings**, reflecting its strong credit profile and diversified business operations. The ratings agency cited Reliance's counter-cyclical business segments, international exposure, and financial discipline as key factors supporting the upgrade. However, Moody's maintained a two-notch cap on the rating due to Reliance's significant linkages to the domestic economy through its retail and digital businesses.  The stable outlook reflects expectations for continued earnings growth across most of its business segments.

top_stories.title: Social Security payment change will affect 3.6 million beneficiaries: What Direct Express users need to know | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **US Department of the Treasury** is transitioning the Direct Express prepaid debit card program from **Comerica Bank** to **Fifth Third Bank**, affecting an estimated 3.6 million cardholders. The change will involve replacing existing cards with new ones issued by **Fifth Third Bank**.  Beneficiaries should continue receiving their benefits normally and can expect advance notice before receiving a replacement card.

top_stories.title: Dhinakaran slams TVK govt. for not launching ‘Singa Penn’ special police wing - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **T.T.V. Dhinakaran**, general secretary of the **Amma Makkal Munnetra Kazhagam (AMMK)**, criticized the **Tamil Nadu** government for its delay in establishing the Singapenn special police wing to address violence against women. He questioned **Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay's** commitment to women's safety after he had previously approved the wing's formation during his swearing-in ceremony. Dhinakaran also expressed concern about the state's current government, suggesting that it lacks the necessary leadership and integrity to ensure public safety.

top_stories.title: PTI claims MNA Junaid Akbar, other leaders arrested during election campaign, later expelled from GB - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **PTI** claims its president in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, MNA Junaid Akbar and other party leaders were arrested and expelled from Gilgit-Baltistan during an election campaign. The party alleges the arrests were politically motivated and a violation of constitutional rights.  They claim that PML-N leaders are receiving VIP treatment while their own party is being targeted. **Omar Ayub**, former National Assembly opposition leader, condemned the arrest, while **KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi** threatened to visit GB to investigate the situation.

top_stories.title: Five killed in Lebanon as Israeli forces advance across key Litani River | Israel attacks Lebanon News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Israeli** forces crossed the Litani River in Lebanon, escalating their ground offensive. At least five people were killed in Israeli air strikes targeting southern Lebanese towns, including Abbasiyeh and Deir Qanoun al-Nahr. The attacks come amid intensified violence following a ceasefire extension that began on May 17th. **Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu** visited troops near the border, confirming Israel's advance into Lebanon.  The **United Nations Children’s Agency (UNICEF)** reported that over 15 children have been killed and 62 injured in the past seven days alone, with an average of 11 children killed or injured every 24 hours.  **Lebanon** is demanding a ceasefire from **Israel**, while humanitarian organizations fear they may be forced to withdraw from southern Lebanon due to ongoing attacks.

top_stories.title: Former head monk of China's Shaolin 'kung fu' temple jailed for embezzlement
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Shi Yongxin**, the former head of China's Shaolin Temple, has been sentenced to 24 years in prison for embezzlement and bribery. **Shi**, who had misappropriated temple assets worth over $42 million, also used his position to obtain millions from construction projects and bribe Chinese officials. The 1,500-year-old temple, known globally for its kung fu traditions, has been a source of cultural influence in pop culture, including films and video games.

top_stories.title: First of trapped men rescued from flooded Laos cave | Laos | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **International** diving teams, including those who worked on the 2018 Thai cave rescue, have been working tirelessly to free seven men trapped in a flooded cave in Laos for over a week.  The first man was successfully rescued and is safe, but four remain inside a chamber about 300 meters from the entrance. **Josh Richards**, an Australian cave diver, stated that rescuers plan to attempt to bring out the remaining four men tomorrow. The rescue operation faces challenges due to unstable walls and flooding, requiring skilled divers to navigate narrow passages in murky water.  Additional divers are expected to arrive on Friday, while heavy machinery is being used to clear a route to the site.

top_stories.title: Dell shares soar more than 30% on strong earnings - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Dell**, a leading PC manufacturer, saw its AI server revenue soar to $16.1 billion in the recent quarter, surpassing its traditional PC business and contributing significantly to the company's increased market value of $206 billion. Analysts praised **Dell's** strong execution and argued it is the best way to play in the AI market.  The company's focus on AI servers and infrastructure solutions has outperformed its PC business, while also benefiting from strong demand for CPU racks from AI cloud providers like **CoreWeave** and **Nscale**.

top_stories.title: Scientists just found a lost river world buried beneath Antarctica’s ice for 34 million years | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: An international team of researchers, led by **Durham University**, has discovered 31 ancient river plains beneath the East Antarctic Ice Sheet. These surfaces, formed over 80 million years ago when Antarctica and Australia were joined, are thought to be slowing the flow of glaciers today. The discovery, using ice-penetrating radar, challenges current climate models by highlighting a previously unknown factor influencing ice movement.  Further research is needed to determine how these ancient landscapes influenced past ice flows and improve projections of future ice loss.
